prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Seu nome é famoso nos antigos calendários da Igreja de Roma.

meta.face: A Roman youth of about fifteen, visibly a boy and not a young man, BEARDLESS, with a fair, lightly sun-warmed complexion and a HEART-SHAPED face — a BROAD, smooth, rounded forehead, wide cheekbones tapering to a SMALL, POINTED chin, a small, straight nose, LARGE, clear GREY eyes under fine, arched light-brown brows, a small, bow-shaped mouth; STRAIGHT light-brown hair, cut short, with one lock falling over the brow; the gaze lifted a little, bright and steady. Not the round, curly pancras, the wide, flat venantius_camerino, the short, wide, bowl-fringed Celsus of nazarius_celsus, or the chubby, curly Martialis of seven_brothers; no curls.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the Martyrology gives only 'A Palestrina nel Lazio, sant'Agapito, martire', and the book a youth martyred at Praeneste under Aurelian. His legend makes him fifteen or sixteen and of a noble Praenestine family, which the toga praetexta and bulla show; the face is ours.
